name: robotics/fleet-controller
definition: Subject may issue motion and coordination commands for the fleet.
data-schema: fleet-controller-data = { * tstr => any }   ; free map, recommended: fleet: tstr
title: Fleet controller
description: Required for ATEP-R motion commands (or a fleet-member with a peer-motion delegation) and, together with safety-certified, for actuation commands.
subject: Agent ID of the controller
attestation-schema:
attestation = {
  subject: agent-id,
  issuer: agent-id,                      ; MUST equal the envelope signer
  claim: uri,
  data: { * tstr => any },
  ? evidence: bstr .size 32,
  ? evidence-uri: uri,
  id: bstr .size 16,
}
agent-id = bstr .size 32
uri = tstr
lifetime: 30 to 180 days by default, 400 days at most
